title.why: MFA page heading and article text give the exact title.

date_published.why: Signing ceremony 16 Jul 2026 in Shanghai (MFA page).

status.why: 29 founding members signed; no stored page gives entry-into-force or ratification terms, so 'Adopted, not yet in force' is provisional, as the verification note says. One web search found no ratification or entry-into-force information.

issuing_body.why: Supported by the signing-ceremony page and the Georgian embassy item. The new value is long and carries the open-for-signature remark; wording is acceptable but the cut-off date is a status detail that belongs in notes.

legal_force.why: The quote shows WAICO is an intergovernmental organisation created by agreement; binding force of a treaty signed but not yet ratified is a legal judgment. Defensible.

notes.why: 'First proposed by China at WAIC in July 2025' is in no stored file (the extractor flags this too). Every other claim in notes was found: 16 Jul signing, 29 countries, Wang Yi, Kazakhstan/Laos/Pakistan/Russia/Indonesia, open until 31 Jul, Georgia's signature on 31 Jul, 'independent intergovernmental international organization', and the Chair's Statement line that WAICO shall be open to all countries.

language.why: Value is a remark ('Not confirmed ...'), not a language; no stored page gives the authentic languages.

safety_topics.why: One topic only; AGENTS.md 5.6 requires 2 to 6. The stored text ('beneficial, safe and fair direction') would support a second topic, but that is a human choice.

summary_claims.locator: MFA page, 'The Organization is headquartered in Shanghai, China'

summary_claims.claim: Aims to ensure AI develops in a 'beneficial, safe and fair direction'

scope.note: Intergovernmental treaty on AI cooperation and governance.

note: The extracted changes are well supported (signing, 29 founding members, 31 Jul close of signature). Needs a human for three items with no stored evidence: the July 2025 proposal claim in notes, the non-language value in language, and a single safety topic. Status stays provisional until a treaty text or depositary notice is stored.
